morphology.pattern_note: 词根以元音 a 起首；meN- 取 meng-，构成 mengansur，原有元音保留。ber- + ansur → beransur；ansur + -an → ansuran。

word_family.gloss: 逐渐变化；缓缓移动或离开

senses.nuances: 此义通常由 beransur-ansur 或 secara beransur-ansur 表达；不宜把裸词 ansur 当作任何句子中都可独立使用的副词。各义项依据派生形式归纳，马来文释义据 [DBP：ansur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=ansur) 改写。

senses.en_definition: To change progressively into a particular condition.
senses.ms_definition: Berubah sedikit demi sedikit kepada sesuatu keadaan.
senses.nuances: 通常用 beransur 后接状态词。变化本身可以向好，也可以向坏；该词并不自带好转之意。

senses.zh_definition: 缓缓移动、挪动，或逐渐离开某处。
senses.en_definition: To move slowly or leave a place gradually.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak perlahan-lahan atau meninggalkan sesuatu tempat secara berperingkat.
senses.nuances: 移动义可见于 beransur 或 mengansur；离席时 Saya beransur dahulu 是较委婉的告辞表达。

collocations.zh: 陆续回家；准备告辞回家

senses.zh_definition: 分次偿还款项，或一点一点地完成工作。
senses.en_definition: To pay in instalments or complete work little by little.
senses.ms_definition: Membayar atau menyelesaikan sesuatu sedikit demi sedikit.
senses.nuances: 常用 mengansur；正式付款说明也常写 membayar secara ansuran。ansuran 是名词，不能与动词 ansur 任意替换。

collocations.en: work through a task little by little

senses.zh_definition: 把物品向前推、递或送过去。
senses.en_definition: To move, push or pass something forward.
senses.ms_definition: Menyorongkan atau menghulurkan sesuatu ke hadapan.
senses.nuances: 主要由 mengansurkan 表达，较偏书面叙述；日常口语往往直接说 hulurkan 或 tolak，具体取决于动作。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Operasi syarikat beransur pulih selepas bekalan elektrik dipulihkan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 电力供应恢复后，公司的营运逐步恢复。
dual_scenarios.en: The company's operations gradually recovered after the electricity supply was restored.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku nak ansur balik dulu, ya. Dah lewat ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya hendak beransur pulang dahulu kerana hari sudah lewat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我先回去啦，已经很晚了。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm going to head home now. It's getting late.
spoken_features: ansur balik 是口语表达，标准对应 beransur pulang。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku nak ansur balik dulu, ya. Esok kerja awal.
messages.ms_standard: Saya hendak beransur pulang dahulu kerana saya perlu mula bekerja awal esok.
messages.zh: 我先回去啦，明天得一早上班。
messages.en: I'm going to head off. I've got an early start tomorrow.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, hati-hati kat jalan. Dah sampai nanti mesej, ya.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, berhati-hati di jalan raya. Hantarkan mesej apabila kamu sudah tiba.
messages.zh: 好，路上小心。到了发个消息呀。
messages.en: Okay, get home safely. Text me when you get there.

etymology.historical_story: Ansur links several familiar experiences through gradual movement: a person edges forward, a situation changes, and a debt is reduced payment by payment. Its derivatives preserve that shared image. The established expression tolak ansur adds the separate idea of mutual accommodation. These connections explain the word family without claiming an unsupported ancient source or a particular historical borrowing.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“慢慢挪”：身体慢慢挪是 beransur，状态慢慢变是 beransur pulih，欠款慢慢还便有 ansuran。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya beransur dahulu 可用于拜访或聚会后的委婉告辞；加上 Minta diri dahulu 更能明确表达礼貌离席。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: tolak ansur 是表示互相迁就或妥协的固定组合，不应把裸词 ansur 直接译成“宽容”。[DBP：bertolak ansur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=bertolak+ansur)
